R1: Walk me through how you would build a performance marketing strategy from scratch for an e-commerce platform.
Explain the difference between CPM, CPC, CPA, and CPL. In what scenarios would you optimize for each?
Calculate CTR, CPC, conversion rate, and CPA from: 100,000 impressions, 5,000 clicks, 200 conversions, ₹2,00,000 spend.
Explain how the Facebook Ads auction works. What factors determine ad delivery and cost?

Explain attribution modeling. Compare first-touch, last-touch, linear, time-decay, and data-driven attribution.
Our Facebook Ads have great CTR (3%) but poor conversion (0.5%). How would you diagnose the problem?

Design an A/B testing framework for ad creative with 3 images, 2 headlines, and 2 CTAs.

Explain incrementality in marketing. How would you measure if paid marketing is truly incremental?
Design a seasonal marketing calendar for an e-commerce platform.
How would you optimize Google Shopping product feed quality?
Give 10 examples of negative keywords for an electronics e-commerce platform.
Build an LTV model to justify higher CAC. Channel A: ₹600 CAC, 50% repeat. Channel B: ₹400 CAC, 20% repeat. Which is better over 2 years?
R2: Case: ROAS Decline - Google Ads ROAS dropped from 5:1 to 3:1 despite no changes. Diagnose and fix.
Case: Channel Expansion - Currently 80% on Google/Facebook. Evaluate Affiliates, Influencers, and YouTube for diversification.
Case: Geographic Expansion - Launching in 10 tier-2 cities. How would paid marketing differ from metros?
Case: Brand vs. Performance - CMO wants 30% budget for brand building without direct attribution. How do you balance?
Case: Competitor Aggression - Competitor bidding on your brand keywords, driving up CPCs 50%. What's your response?
Case: Creative Fatigue - Facebook ad creative has fatigued after 3 months. How do you maintain a pipeline of fresh ads?
Case: Attribution Chaos - 8 channels, multiple touchpoints per customer. How do you build a fair attribution model?
Case: Budget Cuts - 40% budget cut. Maintain 70% of revenue with 60% of budget. What do you cut?
Case: App vs. Web - App users have 3x higher LTV. Should you shift budget from web to app install campaigns?
Case: Fraud Detection - 15% of clicks from a source don't convert and show suspicious patterns. How do you detect ad fraud?
Case: Holiday Sale - ₹2 crore budget to drive maximum GMV in one week. Build your campaign strategy.
Case: Funnel Optimization - 1M visitors, 100K add-to-cart, 50K checkout, 30K purchase. What stage to optimize?
Case: Platform Policy Violation - Facebook disabled your ad account. You're losing ₹10 lakhs/day. How do you handle?
Case: Dynamic Product Ads - Launch dynamic retargeting for 50,000 products. How to structure catalog and audiences?
Case: Influencer ROI - Paid ₹50,000 for a post, got 50 conversions worth ₹1.5 lakhs GMV. Was this a good investment?
